actionType.description: Which form to render: executeAward, recordDebriefRequests, deliverDebriefings, followUpQuestions, protestWindow, agencyPosition, recordDecision

solicitationId.description: Solicitation number; key into Data Fabric

awardDraft.description: Contract award summary drafted by the robot (JSON)

debriefDrafts.description: Debriefings drafted per requesting offeror, with disclosure checks (JSON)

protestAnalysis.description: Protest grounds mapped to the record (JSON)

decision.description: The outcome the person chose (e.g. Signed, Protest filed, Defend)

payload.description: The form's result (JSON or document text)
